tools.name: search_stops
tools.description: Find AMTAB bus stops in Bari by partial name (e.g. 'Torrente'), 8-character stop code (e.g. '05508101') or city landmark/POI (e.g. 'Stazione Centrale', 'Policlinico', 'Aeroporto'). tools.name: find_nearby_stops
tools.description: List AMTAB bus stops within a radius of GPS coordinates in Bari, sorted by distance in meters. Returns stops only, no arrival times. Use it when you have latitude/longitude; for a name or landmark use search_stops; for arrivals near coordinates in one step use get_next_buses with lat/lon.
